sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Reaperman vs Goblins lies a simple yet engaging gameplay mechanic. Players control the Reaperman character, navigating through a procedurally generated forest filled with goblins. The game's core objective is to kill the goblins using a range of deadly combos and magical attacks. The game features three primary attack types: knife, fire, and stick. Each attack has its unique strengths and weaknesses, requiring players to master timing and strategy to succeed. Players can also unleash two special attacks: fireball and lightning, which can be upgraded as you progress through the game.

The game's controls are responsive and intuitive, allowing players to seamlessly switch between the different attack types. The game also features a variety of power-ups and upgrades, which can be collected throughout the levels to enhance the Reaperman's abilities. These power-ups can range from increased health to temporary invincibility, making it easier to navigate the increasingly challenging levels.

The game's difficulty curve is steep, but manageable, making it an ideal choice for players who enjoy a challenge. As you progress through the levels, the goblins become increasingly aggressive, requiring players to think strategically and anticipate their movements. The game's AI is intelligent, adapting to the player's playstyle and presenting a unique challenge each time they play.

One of the game's standout features is its adaptive difficulty system. The game adjusts the difficulty level based on the player's performance, ensuring that the game remains challenging but not impossible to complete. This system makes the game accessible to players of all skill levels, inviting them to play and experiment with different strategies.
